name: Kimi ka Aoiro.
source:
The protagonist, who has lost her parents and grandmother, was taken in by her uncle, her only remaining family.
Emotionally unstable and unable to accept the death of her family, she's swept into complicated relationships with the boys he meets at the school she transfers to.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/18222]Freem![/url]]
